import Base

# Missing samples are the zero extension of the finite board.
def head0(xs: List<&2, U32>) -> U32:
  Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, xs), 0)

def rows(fuel: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match fuel:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      List.take(&2, U32, cells, width) <>
        rows(rest, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

# Each output is the sum of a three-cell horizontal window.
def horizontal(cells: List<&2, U32>, left: U32) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case +center <> +right:
      (left + center + head0(right) : U32) <> horizontal(right, center)

# The inclusive 3x3 sum turns B3/S23 into total = 3 or total = 4 with life.
def resolve(cells: List<&2, U32>, +above: List<&2, U32>, +here: List<&2, U32>, +below: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case alive <> rest:
      +total = (head0(above) + head0(here) + head0(below) : U32)
      next = Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(U32.is_eq(total, 3),
        Bool.and(U32.is_eq(total, 4), U32.is_eq(alive, 1))))
      next <> resolve(rest, List.tail(&2, U32, above),
        List.tail(&2, U32, here), List.tail(&2, U32, below))

def sweep(board: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>, above: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match board:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case +row <> +rest:
      +here = horizontal(row, 0)
      below = horizontal(Maybe.default(&2, List<&2, U32>,
        List.head(&2, List<&2, U32>, rest), Nil{}), 0)
      List.append(&2, U32, resolve(row, above, here, below), sweep(rest, here))

def step(width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  sweep(rows(U32.to_nat(height), U32.to_nat(width), cells), Nil{})

def evolve(turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
